data.gender_notes: Prasanjit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings joy and happiness. The name Prasanjit carries the meaning “Granting Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Prasanjit usually hope their child will grow to embody granting joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing joy and peace to the soul
data.etymology: Prasanjit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Granting Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prasanjit total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Prasanjit is derived from the Sanskrit words 'prasanna' meaning joy, happiness, peace, and 'jit' meaning victory or conqueror. This name is significant in Hindu culture as it represents an individual who not only triumphs over challenges but also spreads positivity and joy in their wake.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Prasanjit holds deep spiritual significance as it reflects the inner peace and contentment of the soul. It represents a person who has achieved inner tranquility and radiates happiness, spreading joy and positivity around them. This name is a reminder of the ultimate goal of Hindu spirituality - to attain Moksha by purifying the soul and living a virtuous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Prasanjit: Bringer of peace and serenity. One who calms the mind and soothes the soul.

historical_references.reference: Prasanjit was a king of the Kalinga Empire, ruling from around 273 to 237 BC. He is best known for his war with Emperor Ashoka, which led to the Edict of Kalinga and Ashoka's conversion to Buddhism.

Prasenjit was also the name of a king of the Vakataka Dynasty, ruling from around 550 to 560 AD. He is known for his patronage of arts and culture, particularly for building the Ajanta Caves, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Prasanjit, derived from Sanskrit, translates to 'pleasing the senses'. In modern contexts, it is seen as an elegant and unique name, reflecting the rich heritage of Hindu culture. Prasanjit is increasingly popular on social media platforms, with many users adopting it as a username or display name. In the business world, it can be found among entrepreneurs and professionals, often used as a company name or personal brand. The entertainment industry, particularly Bollywood, has also seen an uptick in the use of Prasanjit, with actors and characters bearing the name becoming more common.
